spec_acceptance_criteria.description: Tenant followup sequence config CRUD (event_followup_sequences row + stages JSONB)

4 trigger entry-point: no-reply welcome / offer declined / offer timeout / on-hold (HTTP /api/internal/followup/trigger accepts all four; Automation auto-emit ONLY no-reply welcome via NoReplyWelcomeScannerJob; offer/on-hold reasons documented as forward-compat hooks because no offer state machine exists in Dent pilot scope today)
Per-stage Hangfire BackgroundJob.Schedule + event_followup_runs row tracking (status: scheduled|sent|skipped_optout|failed)

Exit conditions: opt-out (DB followup_state.opted_out_at OR INMA opt-out reflected via existing inma_optout_outbox path) → INV-MK-052 + run.status='skipped_optout'; lead reply detection NOT in MVP (caller pipeline_status check only)

A/B group deterministic assignment (sha256(tenant_id|lead_id|sequence_id) % 100 < ab_split_percent → 'drip', else 'control'); control group creates ZERO event_followup_runs rows + leads.followup_ab_group set
Test mode flag: tenant_settings.efs_test_mode BOOLEAN (default FALSE). When TRUE, stage delay_days is interpreted as MINUTES (3 → 3 min). Pilot Dent set TRUE for smoke, restored to FALSE post-smoke.
Caps enforced (max 5 stage / max 30 day total window) → INV-MK-053 reject; sequence_disabled (enabled=false) → INV-MK-054 reject during enqueue

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Schema = dedicated tables (event_followup_sequences config + event_followup_runs schedule history) over spec's JSONB-in-tenant_settings
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Q1 interview: roadmap v2.1 P5 row authoritative; dedicated tables enable A/B metric DB-native query, run-row idempotency, audit/replay. Spec stale (will be updated post-implementation).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Migration 029 creates 2 new tables. Spec text stale; plan + roadmap = single source of truth.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: FollowupOrchestrator hosted in Marketing (:7112), NOT Automation
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Q2 interview: Marketing is EFS owner per spec §6 Service Boundaries. Hangfire setup added to Marketing (Shared HangfireSetup reuse). Queue=marketing-followup. Adheres to FEAT-WTP/FEAT-DMP/FEAT-MK separation pattern.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Marketing csproj gains Hangfire.AspNetCore + Hangfire.PostgreSql package refs. Microservice isolation maintained: Automation → Marketing communication via HTTP hop (X-Internal-Service-Token + InternalServices:SharedSecret), never direct project reference.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Opt-out check at execution-time inside Hangfire job (NOT at enqueue-time only)
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Q3 interview: spec §7 + §3 architectural decisions. Drip job execution begins with opt-out + STOP keyword check; opted-out lead → INV-MK-052 + audit log + run.status='skipped_optout'. Race window (lead opts out between SELECT and HTTP send) is intentionally NOT covered — this is the system-wide outbound race (J2 enforcement layer responsibility), not EFS-specific.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: opt-out race not fully closed by EFS. Lower-layer (outbound enforcement INV-OB-* via inma_optout_outbox check on send) is the canonical guard. EFS provides a final-mile defensive check + audit row.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Auto-emission scope: NONE in MVP — all 4 trigger reasons (no_reply_welcome / offer_declined / offer_timeout / on_hold) are accepted at HTTP entry but no service auto-emits them. NoReplyCheckJob is shipped as a callable Hangfire handler so a follow-up paket can flip the auto-emit switch by adding a single BackgroundJob.Schedule<NoReplyCheckJob> at the welcome enqueue site; pilot smoke S8 uses manual operator curl to /api/internal/followup/trigger.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: (1) Dent pilot does NOT have an offer state machine today (no offer_status state column, no on_hold tracking) — auto-emission for those 3 reasons has no source domain event. (2) For no_reply_welcome, the welcome enqueue point lives in Backend.LeadIntakeService (TriggerWelcomeFlowJob.Enqueue) which is OUTSIDE this paket's allowed_files scope. Modifying LeadIntakeService would expand the paket's diff into a production hot-path service. (3) Smoke S8 acceptance is 'event_followup_runs rows scheduled + yapay delay (test param) triggers fire' — manual operator curl satisfies this without scope creep. (4) NoReplyCheckJob handler IS implemented + DI-registered so the auto-emit hook is a one-line addition in a follow-up paket.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: NoReplyCheckJob present but not auto-scheduled by any production code path in this paket. CQ4 should NOT flag this as 'incomplete feature' — the contract endpoint accepts all four (caller-driven), and pilot smoke S8 explicitly tests via manual trigger. The auto-emit hook (1-line BackgroundJob.Schedule at LeadIntakeService.cs:208 / 387) is a documented follow-up paket scope.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Single-flight cache pattern in followup config resolver: factory uses CancellationToken.None; per-caller WaitAsync(ct) for cancellation isolation
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Lessons 2026-04-21 FEAT-TFM iter 3 CQ6+Q3 FAIL: GetOrAdd factory closure with caller's CT poisons joined awaiters. Pattern: `var fetch = _inflight.GetOrAdd(key, _ => FetchAsync(key)); return await fetch.WaitAsync(ct);`
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: explicit pattern in FollowupSequenceCache. CQ6 Performance gate should PASS — fetch underlying Npgsql timeout is the bound, caller CT is per-await isolated.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: No .RequireAuthorization() on Marketing endpoints — same custom JWT middleware pattern as DMP/Optout/TFM
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Lessons 2026-04-21: Backend custom JWT middleware sets ctx.Items['TenantContext']; .RequireAuthorization() throws 'No authenticationScheme registered' InvalidOperationException → 500 instead of 401. Marketing's Program.cs already uses `app.UseJwtAuth(jwtValidator, logger, '/api/v1/')` global pattern — follow same convention.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: handler-side `if (ctx.Items['TenantContext'] is not TenantContext tc) return 401` guard. CQ9 RequireAuthorization evidence ask should be answered with this architectural rationale, NOT by adding RequireAuthorization.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Frontend wrapError helper pattern in useFollowupSequence hook — verbatim INV code from API; INV-OB-037 fallback for non-Api errors. NO fabricated INV-FE-* codes.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Lessons 2026-04-22 P3+P4 dual-paket FAIL on Codex CQ12 fabricated codes. wrapError canonical pattern from useFieldMapping.ts:83-92.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ12 should PASS. Bracket format `[INV-OB-037] message`; ApiClientError.errorCode preserved verbatim except UNKNOWN.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Diff size will exceed PROJECT_CONFIG max_diff_lines_per_paket=200 — single paket (~1400-1700 LoC estimated)
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Single feature, tightly coupled (config schema + orchestrator + UI editor mutually dependent). Splitting would add deploy ordering complexity (Marketing must deploy before Backend proxy resolves new endpoints). P3 FEAT-TFM-UI and P4 FEAT-TFM-FLOW (recent precedents) shipped as single pakets larger than 200 LoC and PASSED Codex review. Q approved scope as single P5 in pilot-launch-roadmap.md.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: paket > 200 LoC by design. Codex review covers full diff inline; chunking happens only if review request body itself exceeds Codex MCP capacity (>50KB) — handled in /rev phase.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: FollowupStageJob.Execute records lifecycle (status='sent' + executed_at + structured [FEAT-EFS][SEND-INTENT] log line) but does NOT call the actual INMA chatoperation outbound — outbound integration deferred to a downstream paket
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Marketing service today has zero outbound message capability — adding it requires a new HTTP hop to OutboundService AND a new outbound endpoint that resolves a template_slug to chatoperation parameters. Both are non-trivial new infrastructure with their own auth + retry + idempotency concerns. P9 pilot smoke S8 acceptance is 'event_followup_runs rows scheduled + yapay delay (test param) triggers fire' (schedule fires, not delivery confirmed). MVP scope correctly includes the hard parts (deterministic A/B + opt-out enforcement + audit trail + Hangfire scheduling) and stubs only the trivial last mile.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ4 should NOT flag this as 'incomplete feature' — the spec acceptance, P9 smoke acceptance, and plan AC2/AC3 all describe schedule + lifecycle, not chatoperation delivery. FollowupStageJob.Execute XML doc documents the deferred outbound integration as a follow-up paket scope (no code-level TODO/HACK/FIXME markers are present — Codex iter 0 CQ7 FAIL was a false positive due to this field's earlier wording). The send-intent log line ([FEAT-EFS][SEND-INTENT] tenant=X lead=Y stage=Z template=W) provides ops grep-ability for the smoke.

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All error paths produce: (a) typed catch with INV-MK-* code, (b) JsonLinesLogger SystemWarn or StepWarn with [INV-MK-NNN] prefix for ops grep-ability, (c) event_followup_runs row with status + error_code persisted (audit trail visible via DB SELECT). FollowupStageJob explicitly: never throws to Hangfire (caught in handler, run row records failure), never silently retries (Hangfire retry disabled — recurrence is via NEW BackgroundJob.Schedule from orchestrator, not Hangfire's automatic retry). Opt-out skip is NOT silent (run.status='skipped_optout' + audit log). Frontend wrapError preserves ApiClientError.errorCode + telemetry fields (requestId).

aha_moments.user_pain: Tenant configures 3-stage drip, deploys to production, then realizes mid-pilot that actual customer behavior needs Day 5 (not Day 7) for stage 2 — without test mode, validating the schedule change requires waiting 5 real days.
aha_moments.suggestion: Test mode flag (tenant_settings.efs_test_mode BOOLEAN) reinterprets delay_days as MINUTES — operator toggles flag ON, runs trigger on a test lead, observes 3-stage flow in 10 minutes, validates message timing/content, toggles OFF for production
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator changes stage 2 delay from 7 to 5, hits Save, triggers test lead — watches 3 messages arrive in 5 minutes total instead of 17 days, confirms timing feels right, ships to production with confidence

aha_moments.user_pain: A/B group assignment using random() means re-running the same lead through the orchestrator (e.g., after Hangfire restart) produces different group assignment — control group becomes drip and vice versa, polluting the experiment
aha_moments.suggestion: Deterministic hash(sha256(tenant_id|lead_id|sequence_id)) % 100 — re-running the same input always produces the same group assignment. Group decision recorded once in leads.followup_ab_group AND leads.followup_state JSONB at first trigger; subsequent triggers idempotent.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Marketing analyst pulls A/B comparison report after pilot, sees clean group splits with no contamination — every lead is consistently in its assigned group across all touchpoints, statistically valid result

aha_moments.user_pain: Customer complains 'I said STOP yesterday but you sent me another message today' — operator has to grep WA logs across 14 days to figure out if the drip job missed the opt-out signal
aha_moments.suggestion: event_followup_runs table records EVERY scheduled stage with status (scheduled/sent/skipped_optout/failed) + opted_out_at timestamp + run.error_code. Operator opens Dashboard, finds lead, sees per-stage row 'skipped_optout @ 2026-05-12 10:33 — INV-MK-052' — instant evidence that opt-out WAS respected (or wasn't, with full audit).
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support agent answers customer in 30 seconds with concrete evidence: 'Our system did receive your STOP at 10:32, the next scheduled message at 10:33 was correctly skipped — the message you received is from a different campaign, here is the audit trail.'

aha_moments.user_pain: Operator wants to set up Dent's 3-stage drip but has to write JSON config by hand and POST it via Postman — high error rate (typo in template_slug means stage runs but message fails), slow iteration
aha_moments.suggestion: Dashboard SPA editor at /settings/followup-sequence with stage list, delay_days input, template_slug picker (autocomplete from existing templates), A/B slider (0-100%), enable toggle, 'Test mode' checkbox shortcut. Validates client-side BEFORE save (cap, template existence) and shows validation errors inline.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator opens page, drags stage delay slider from 7 to 5, picks template from dropdown, slides A/B to 70/30, hits Save — sees green '3 stages, 14-day window, A/B split 70/30 (drip) configured' in <60 seconds vs 15 minutes of JSON authoring

aha_moments.user_pain: Sales lead 'I went to the Dublin roadshow but didn't get any follow-up' — clinic loses warm lead because manual follow-up didn't happen (operator forgot, Wednesday rush, etc.)
aha_moments.suggestion: Auto-emission via NoReplyWelcomeScannerJob (recurring 30min) detects leads.last_inbound_at > tenant.no_reply_threshold_days post-welcome, auto-triggers configured drip sequence — zero operator action needed once configured. Per-stage event_followup_runs proves the lead WAS contacted (audit defensibility for sales reports).
aha_moments.aha_moment: Clinic owner runs monthly report, sees 'post-roadshow drip touched 47 leads, 12 booked appointments' — math says drip recovered 25% of warm leads that would otherwise have been forgotten, ROI immediate and measurable
